name: Article 4, § 1 – 354
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council on the Union Civil Protection Mechanism and Union support for health emergency preparedness and response, and repealing Decision No 1313/2013/EU (Union Civil Protection Mechanism)
part_text: 1. The general objective of this Regulation shall be to strengthen cooperation between the Union and the Member States to prevent, prepare for and respond to all kinds of natural and human-induced disasters and serious cross-border threats to health, that may occur inside or outside the Union, as well as to support cooperation in the consequence management of situations that impact several sectors simultaneously, including complex crises with multiple, long lasting and cascading effects requiring coordinated actions.
